v1Deprecation: Formal from 1.17.8; v1.17.10 security fix was still published 2026-09-10. Do not claim all maintenance ceased.
securityScope: No GridFS exploit-path or final vulnerability scan claim. Candidate uses only bson/mongo/options for filer metadata, not GridFS APIs.

retryReview.unchanged: retryReads and retryWrites settings/default remain driver-owned; no OUF retry policy added
retryReview.protocol: Supported retryable mutations use sessions and txnNumber; standalone test fixtures explicitly disable retries. Live replica-set/sharded dedup/failover is not qualified.
retryReview.csot: Both v1.17.9 and v2.9.2 source permit retries until a CSOT deadline, not universally one retry.
retryReview.newV2Feature: Adaptive overload retries default2 (Atlas9+) are explicitly set to0 in this profile. Positive maxAdaptiveRetries or true enableOverloadRetargeting are rejected before Connect; existing retryWrites/read behavior and defaults are preserved.
retryReview.wireProof: Standalone TCP driver test observes one attempted update and propagates overload16500 with labels. Control removing SetMaxAdaptiveRetries(0) retries into canned success and fails the regression test. No real Atlas9, replica-set, dedup, durable recovery, or PITR claim.
